sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, th  following:
 ORDER 1.

This is repeat bail application filed under Section 439 CrPC on behalf of applicant who is in custody since 1.6.2022 in connection with Crime No.514/2022 registered at Police Station Adhartal,
District Jabalpur (M.P.), for the offence punishable under sections 420, 120-B and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that there was civil dispute between the parties and matter has now been compromised.
Complainant does not have any grievance from applicant and he does not have any objection if applicant is released on bail.

3. Learned counsel for the complainant submitted that though he has received oral instructions in the matter and compromise has also been arrived at between the parties but he is yet to file Vakalatnama in the case.
He prays that he may be permitted to file Vakalatnama during the course of the day.

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the complainant may file Vakalatnama during the course of the day.
5. Learned Govt. Advocate appearing for the respondent/State opposed the prayer for grant of bail and submitted that case diary is not available.

6. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
7.
Considering the fact that offence is triable by J.M.F.C and is punishable upto 7 years and the fact that applicant is in custody since 1.6.2022, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

8. It is directed that applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the trial court on the dates to be fixed by the trial court.

9. The applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
C.C as per rules.
